mainEntity.name: What is the purpose of the BHMarketer Street Insider distribution service?

acceptedAnswer.text: It lets businesses, startups and crypto projects work with BHMarketer to buy a press release on Street Insider. Instead of pitching journalists and hoping for coverage, you get a streamlined path to guaranteed editorial publication on a premium financial news site.

mainEntity.name: Who is BHMarketer?

acceptedAnswer.text: BHMarketer (BHMarketer.ai) is a global digital PR, media buying and online reputation management (ORM) agency. It specializes in high-authority media placements, cleaning up search results and improving brand visibility across AI discovery engines.

mainEntity.name: What does it mean to buy a press release on Street Insider?

acceptedAnswer.text: It means using BHMarketer's verified media placement network to purchase a guaranteed slot for your company milestone, funding news or product announcement on the Street Insider financial news portal.

mainEntity.name: What is Street Insider?

acceptedAnswer.text: Street Insider is an influential American financial news and analysis portal. Institutional funds, venture capitalists, day traders and market analysts follow it closely for fast market intelligence.

mainEntity.name: What are the official links to purchase these packages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Order through the official BHMarketer channels: the Get on StreetInsider hub (https://getonstreetinsider.com/) for editorial placements, the Street Insider Standard PR package (https://bhmarketer.ai/products/street-insider/) for general company updates, the Street Insider Crypto Press Release package (https://bhmarketer.ai/products/street-insider-crypto-press-release/) for blockchain and Web3 news, and the Street Insider Crypto Presale package (https://bhmarketer.ai/products/street-insider-crypto-presale/) for early-stage token offerings and roadmap rollouts.

mainEntity.name: How does a Street Insider press release help my Google ranking (SEO)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Street Insider has a Domain Authority of about 76 to 90+ and over 6.4 million indexed backlinks. A placement there sends a strong trust signal to search engines, which can lift your keyword positions and domain rating.

mainEntity.name: Will BHMarketer help my business appear in AI search engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews regularly draw on trusted financial news sites. A Street Insider release bought through BHMarketer becomes an official source those AI systems can cite about your brand.

mainEntity.name: How much web traffic does Street Insider get?

acceptedAnswer.text: Street Insider averages about 2.8 million visits per month and ranks prominently in the investing category, so your announcement gets real market visibility.

mainEntity.name: Can Street Insider placements help with online reputation management (ORM)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. BHMarketer uses high-authority Street Insider articles that rank quickly on search engines. This helps push negative links, complaints or unverified forum threads down to later pages of Google.

mainEntity.name: Are the links do-follow or nofollow?

acceptedAnswer.text: All placements follow the publisher's standard editorial rules for links. Even so, a natural brand mention on a high-trust site carries strong SEO citation value and sends referral traffic.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Street Insider press release cost through BHMarketer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard investor-focused Street Insider packages start from around $35 to $50, depending on the package you choose. Visit the order page for the current price.

mainEntity.name: Are there any hidden upsells or recurring subscription fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Every order with BHMarketer is a transparent, one-time flat fee per article distributed.

mainEntity.name: What do I get with the Standard Street Insider package?

acceptedAnswer.text: A guaranteed, investor-targeted news placement designed to build instant company credibility in traditional financial markets.

mainEntity.name: What do I get with the Crypto Press Release package?

acceptedAnswer.text: A crypto-focused financial distribution built to reach digital asset traders, exchanges and Web3 investors.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the Crypto Presale package?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professionally formatted article covering your blockchain project architecture, token details, development roadmap and upcoming presale launch information.

mainEntity.name: What is the refund policy if my press release fails to publish?

acceptedAnswer.text: BHMarketer offers a 100% refund guarantee. If your brief is accepted but the release does not go live because of a network issue on the publisher side, you get a full refund.

mainEntity.name: Are these articles marked as sponsored content or ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Releases publish through Street Insider's standard editorial format with a contributing author byline. Any labels follow the publisher's own rules, which BHMarketer does not control.

mainEntity.name: Can I submit aggressive sales copy or promotional pitches?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The news desk requires a neutral, objective, third-person journalistic tone. BHMarketer's editors polish your draft so it meets financial wire guidelines.

mainEntity.name: Does BHMarketer write the press release for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every standard package includes a done-for-you (DFY) writing option, where professional writers create a compliant story angle from your basic brief.

mainEntity.name: What content is not allowed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Content involving financial scams, unverified health or medical claims, adult material, hate speech or deceptive stock promotion is rejected.

mainEntity.name: Can I review and change the copy before it goes live?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get full preview access to the draft, and every package includes two rounds of free revisions before final sign-off.

mainEntity.name: How long does the standard Street Insider package take to go live?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard business and financial placements usually go from your approved draft to a live, indexable URL within 3 to 6 days.

mainEntity.name: How fast do the Crypto Press Release and Presale packages go live?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because digital asset markets move fast, the Crypto Press Release and Presale packages are fast-tracked to go live within 2 to 3 days.

mainEntity.name: Will my article show up on Google News?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, typically. Street Insider is a verified news source, so published releases are usually picked up and indexed by Google News.

mainEntity.name: How long does a published article stay on the site?

acceptedAnswer.text: Published articles remain in Street Insider's news archive, subject to the publisher's own policies.

mainEntity.name: Can I schedule a specific date and time for my launch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can choose a future embargo date and time so your release lines up with a product reveal or earnings announcement.

mainEntity.name: Can I fix a typo or change a link after the release goes live?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once a release is pushed to the network feeds, it cannot be edited. Check all links, smart contract addresses and phone numbers during the review stage.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I spot a serious mistake after launch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact the support desk immediately. Live text edits are not possible, but the editorial desk can take the main post down to protect your company.

mainEntity.name: Can a live article be deleted later if requested?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Removal requests can be processed, although it may take a few business days for the deletion to reach every secondary database mirror.

mainEntity.name: Do I get proof of my distribution?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. As soon as syndication finishes, BHMarketer sends a report with the direct live URLs of your published release.

mainEntity.name: How can I contact the team quickly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Message the customer operations team directly on WhatsApp at +1 917 795 8348, or email mojo@wewinconsultants.com.

mainEntity.name: How do I submit an editorial brief or ask about bulk agency discounts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Email your brief, copy questions or bulk agency discount requests to mojo@wewinconsultants.com, or message the team on WhatsApp at +1 917 795 8348.

mainEntity.name: Can I track the traffic my links receive?

acceptedAnswer.text: The news site does not share page analytics publicly, but you can track results by adding standard UTM tags to the links in your draft.

mainEntity.name: Can I include logos, images or videos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic packages are optimized for clean text. Premium tiers let you embed your company logo, product photos or YouTube links to increase reader engagement.

mainEntity.name: Where can I see all the services BHMarketer offers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visit BHMarketer.ai to explore its full range of digital PR, Google review removal and search visibility services.
